## Appearance

Christine Stuart is a tall girl featuring smooth, dark, glossy hair. She is distinguished by her large, dark-blue eyes and clear, ivory-like features.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019)_

## History

Christine Stuart studied music in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) during the winter. She was frequently seen in the company of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), which secretly disquieted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During a reception at Patty's Place, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) observed [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Christine together from across the room and compared herself to Christine.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P15](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0015), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Christine P20](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0020)_
